_comment: Known LaTeX/Quarto divergences, tracked under #3499. The check fails only on divergences NOT listed here. Shrink this file as the trees are reconciled; never grow it to silence a new one. Held at three coverage entries as of 2026-08-02, after 'ch09b_passive_stabilization' was reconciled rather than accepted (#3703): main.tex \includes it between ch09 and ch10, and its sibling ch30b was already mirrored, so its absence was an omission and not the editorial choice this file is for. That is the distinction to apply before adding anything here -- ask whether the book itself carries the chapter. 'ch32_putting' is the opposite case: a 40-line stub that main.tex does not \include either, so it is absent from both editions and the phrase 'website readers cannot reach this chapter' understates it -- no reader can; it is listed because the checker compares directory contents rather than the book's include list. The two 'glossary' entries are a third case: each LaTeX volume carries its own glossary while the Quarto tree has one shared glossary.qmd, so they are a structural choice, not missing content. A stale entry is not idle: it grants standing permission for that exact defect to reappear unnoticed, which is the opposite of what this file is for.
accepted: latex-only|'ch32_putting' exists in articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/chapters but has no Quarto mirror in articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto -- website readers cannot reach this chapter
latex-only|'glossary' exists in articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_0/chapters but has no Quarto mirror in articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto -- website readers cannot reach this chapter
